title: DELSA AI Delivery Protocol Analysis
summary: Analysis of the DELSA AI Delivery Protocol as an enterprise AI-driven software delivery operating system, moving beyond prompt engineering into AI process engineering.
keyInsights: DELSA is evolving from prompt engineering into AI process engineering.
The protocol is system-centric rather than feature-centric.
System Awareness Layer forces impact analysis across Jafam domains.
The manifest can evolve into a machine-readable AI constitution.
strategicConclusion: DELSA can become an enterprise AI delivery framework where AI agents follow explicit architecture, workflow, role, encoding, performance, migration, and observability policies before producing code.
